card.name: News outlet reporting or quoting a source
card.fires_on: The verb or noun that attributes information to a news outlet or press source, such as "reports", "quoted", "reported", or "news release". It appears in news-style articles, often right after a quote.

modes.label: Outlet verb
modes.description: A reporting verb right after a named news outlet.

modes.label: Release or statement
modes.description: The noun release or statement ending a phrase like "said in a press release".
modes.example: Dr. Persaud said in a<< statement>> today.

card.plain: It marks the point where a news story credits a newspaper, agency or press release as its source.
